description:
Activate Throne of Geth by tapping it and sacrificing an artifact creature.
The creature dies, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Throne of Geth trigger, causing you to proliferate.
Venser triggers, creating a legendary 3/3 The Hollow Sentinel artifact creature token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Salvaging Station and The Hollow Sentinel, untapping Throne of Geth.
Repeat.
